mapper.select: SELECT id, categoryId, name, price, image_url, delete_flag FROM product WHERE id = #{productId}

SELECT p.id AS id, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, s.quantity AS stock, c.name AS categoryName, p.image_url AS imageUrl FROM product p INNER JOIN product_category c ON p.categoryId = c.id LEFT JOIN product_stock s ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE p.id = #{productId} AND p.delete_flag = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET delete_flag = 1 WHERE id = #{productId}
